notes.rationale: Kindern is a dative plural noun with plural -n; the surface features carry both case and number. Knowledge (#884): the Reading is a child by age; Knirps stays off as an OpenThesaurus Unterbegriff, Sprössling as the offspring sense, Erwachsene as only a definition's negation; decided by agents under the user's delegation. Göre stays off too: like Knirps it sits in an OpenThesaurus Unterbegriff group (user ruling on #884, 2026-10-03). The nearSynonym Balg is the child sense, which Duden gives as der oder das and DWDS as Balg, der, das, so its gender is mixed Masc and Neut (de/noun-gender-in-free-variation, #1036); der Balg, the skin, is another Lemma.
